Package zephyr.wallet.model

Class ZephyrAssets

java.lang.Object
zephyr.wallet.model.ZephyrAssets
public final class ZephyrAssets extends Object
The V2 asset names of Zephyr, in use since hard fork 11. The asset is an open string everywhere in this library. The V1 names (ZEPH, ZEPHUSD, ZEPHRSV, ZYIELD) can still appear in the history of wallets restored from before that fork and as leftover balance entries; they pass through unchanged and have no constants here.
